review.notes: Full review. All 12 sampled targets and the headline theorems recomputed by hand (adversarial table in the report); Bogacki-Shampine coefficients and orders checked algebraically. Seven Mathlib declarations opened at the pin; supplier citations resolved on main; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry the only warning; unused-hypothesis and one-tactic probes run on a scratch copy. The one automatic check that failed (TeX-style subscript in the display of 2.1) is raised as a format note. Ownership searched against main and the open heads: no other owner.
